title: Agent Chat Request (v2)
description: Request body for POST /api/v2/chat. Identity is conveyed via headers (X-User-ID, x-request-id), not the body.

message.description: Operator prompt sent to the agent runtime.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier to continue an existing conversation. Omit to start a new session.

input_modality.description: Voice-readiness contract (SPEC-022 R-2): modality is metadata only. It never changes policy, auto-allow, or HITL outcomes, and can never approve or deny a parked confirmation.

response_schema.description: Optional JSON-schema dict for kernel-validated structured output (SPEC-017 R-2); passed through unchanged to the agent kernel.

model.description: Optional model selection (SPEC-024 R-3): a model id from GET /api/v2/models. Resolution order is request model > session-pinned model > deploy-time default; an unknown id is refused with 4xx (fail-closed).
